passage.label: When said come Messenger Allah ask forgiveness turn heads aside see evading arrogant; all same whether ask forgiveness or not never Allah forgive them indeed Allah does not guide defiantly disobedient; ones say do not spend those with Messenger Allah until disband; Allah belongs depositories heavens earth hypocrites not understand; say if return Madinah more honored power surely expel more humble; Allah belongs honor Messenger believers hypocrites not know

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ يَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوۡاْ رُءُوسَهُمۡ وَرَأَيۡتَهُمۡ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَسۡتَغۡفَرۡتَ لَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمۡ لَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُواْ عَلَىٰ مَنۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّواْۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ
يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعۡنَآ إِلَى ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ لَيُخۡرِجَنَّ ٱلۡأَعَزُّ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡأَذَلَّۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

mainSubject.label: Their refusal when invited to seek prophetic forgiveness — turning away arrogantly — answered by the declaration that asking or not asking makes no difference since Allah will never forgive them and does not guide the defiantly disobedient; their campaign to withhold spending on those with the Messenger until dispersal, ignorant that Allah owns the cosmic depositories; their boast that returning to Madinah the honoured would expel the humble, unaware that honour belongs entirely to Allah, His Messenger and the believers

subordinateSubjects.label: Refusal to seek prophetic forgiveness by turning away arrogantly

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the propped-timber paranoia and enemy identification (4) before the forgiveness-refusal block opens (5); P2 ends with the honour-attribution correction (8) before the believer-address begins (9); P3 covers the wealth-children warning, the pre-death spending urge and the closing no-delay affirmation (9-11).
